item.title: Documents
item.description: Trustgrid and customers can share documents securely in the Documents section. Adding or deleting documents requires documents::modify permissions. Downloading and viewing documents requires documents::read permissions. (show how to add and delete and download a document).

item.title: Support Requests
item.description: The Support Requests section lets you open a request with the Trustgrid Support Team and follow it through to resolution without leaving the portal. Requests are listed in two columns: Open Support Requests - requests Trustgrid is still working. Past Support Requests - requests that have been closed. Each entry shows the subject, its current status, and when it was last updated. Support requests are submitted with your user account email address, and you see only the requests you opened.
